nodes.label: seed_dummy_data.sql Seed Script
nodes.rationale: Uses high ID values (1000+) to avoid collisions with production data; designed for local Postgres or Docker Compose execution

nodes.label: EntityListPage Generic Component
nodes.rationale: Single reusable component driven by a per-entity config object to avoid duplicating list page code across all 10 entity types; includes search debounce, pagination, and delete AlertDialog

nodes.label: Dashboard Admin API Endpoints
nodes.rationale: New /api/dashboard/admin/{entity} routes added without touching existing /api/dashboard/{entity} endpoints to preserve all existing consumers

nodes.label: Entity Delete Services
nodes.rationale: No new backend DELETE routes needed; uses standard Strapi REST DELETE /api/{entity}/:id protected by require-auth-for-writes; only thin frontend wrappers are new

nodes.label: Form Page Consolidation Pattern
nodes.rationale: Collapses CreateX.tsx + EditX.tsx into a single XFormPage.tsx per entity that reads mode ('create' or 'edit') from the presence of a URL :id param; halves dashboard form component count without touching form internals

nodes.label: Pure Navigation Sidebar
nodes.rationale: Sidebar rows become plain NavLinks to entity list pages; removes embedded create/edit action buttons to enable URL-first navigation and active-state highlighting

nodes.label: Prod Docker nginx Backups Implementation Plan
nodes.norm_label: prod docker nginx backups implementation plan

nodes.label: docker-compose.prod.yml Hardened Production Stack
nodes.rationale: Promotes docker-compose.vps.yml into docker-compose.prod.yml adding Redis, healthchecks with service_healthy conditions, resource limits, log rotation, and pinned postgres:15.4-alpine image to match staging hardening

nodes.label: Backup Shell Script
nodes.rationale: Replaces single-file-overwrite approach with timestamped DB+uploads pairs; uploads volume previously had no backup path; shared timestamp makes pairs identifiable; retention pruning keeps last 15

nodes.label: Systemd Backup Timer Units
nodes.rationale: OnCalendar=*-*-1/2 03:00:00 fires on odd days at 03:00; Persistent=true catches up missed backups after VPS downtime; make install-backup-timer installs and enables automatically

nodes.label: Redis Service in Production
nodes.rationale: Provisioned as redis:7-alpine with --save '' --appendonly no (ephemeral mode) to match staging; REDIS_URL env var wired to backend; Redis application integration code deferred separately

nodes.label: nginx SSL Certificate Auto-Reload
nodes.rationale: certbot renews certs on 12h cycle but nginx only reads TLS cert at startup; 6h nginx -s reload loop in the container command closes the renewal-to-serving gap without a manual restart

nodes.label: Backend Dockerfile Runtime Fixes
nodes.rationale: Removes redundant npm ci --only=production immediately clobbered by COPY --from=builder; uses npm prune --omit=dev instead; adds .dockerignore to prevent host node_modules polluting the COPY context
